Players Committee card image of [[I Don't Like Sand (Errata)]] (errata PC-E1), game text: “Deploy on table; shuffle your Reserve Deck, peek at top two cards, and stack them face-up here. During battle, may take a card here into hand to prevent all battle destiny draws from being modified or canceled (each player may draw no more than one battle destiny). (Immune to Alter.)”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual0-Light/large/idontlikesand.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/35aa2a66de8c2b5feeb1ad348a3a240cdc9ffbef 35aa2a6] (28 March 2021). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged.
